workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots where BOTH are free:

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30, 14:30-15:00
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Brad, please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for them. Prefer the earliest available slot.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots you proposed work for both Elena and David. They are both busy during all the times Priya and Marcus are free.

However, I found the following 30-minute slots where BOTH Elena and David are free. Can you check which of these also work for Priya and Marcus?

- Monday: 11:00-11:30, 11:30-12:00
- Tuesday: 09:00-09:30, 09:30-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-13:30, 13:30-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:00, 15:00-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-15:30, 15:30-16:00

Please check these against Priya and Marcus's calendars. We should prefer the earliest slot that works for all four.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
I checked your proposed slots against Priya and Marcus's calendars. Most don't work, but I found one match:

Thursday 14:30-15:00 works for both Priya and Marcus (both are free this time).

You indicated Thursday 14:30-15:00 is also when both Elena and David are free. So this slot works for all four partners!

I'll proceed to create the booking for Thursday at 14:30.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Booking created: Thursday, November 16, 2026 (wait, November 20) at 14:30-15:00. All four partners invited.

Brad, please send the confirmation email to the partners to complete the task.

emails.body:
Dear Partners,

Your 30-minute meeting has been scheduled for Thursday, November 20, 2026, from 2:30 PM to 3:00 PM Eastern.

All four partners (Priya Raman, Marcus Hale, Elena Soto, and David Okafor) have been invited.

Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Brad & Alison (Hale & Raman LLP Scheduling)
